chunks: What al-Saffār narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Sulaymān ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام, who said:
When you wish to perform ghusl on Friday, then perform wudu (ablution), then perform ghusl.
ai.seo_question: Should wudu (ablution) be performed before Friday ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an instruction concerning the manner of performing ghusl on Friday. It indicates performing wudu (ablution) before the Friday ghusl, within the broader discussion of the falling away of the obligation of wudu.
